title: Pelican Trace Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutPelican Trace ~ 174 Savelle Drive ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Pelican Trace is a recently built, luxurious 4,250 sf home located in the private, Gulf Trace neighborhood with an additional 2,416 sq of outdoor living. With 4 King en-suite bedrooms and 2 half baths (1 leading to enclosed outdoor shower), Pelican Trace will sleep up to 8 guests and offers a private saltwater pool and marvelous glpimses of the Gulf and Grayton Beach State Park. Driveway parking for 4 cars (garage not accessible to guests). Families will love the private, fenced backyard that backs up to the Grayton Beach State Park – lots of room for the kiddies to play on the lawn (yes…actual grass!) while the adults lounge around the amazing 17’ x 30’ saltwater pool! Pelican Trace is a very short walk to either of the two private neighborhood beach access – just walk past 6 houses to put your toes in the sand. Being surrounded by the Grayton Beach State Park gives guests ONE FULL MILE of beautiful, undisturbed beaches to enjoy. PLEASE NOTE - Golf carts and on-street parking are STRICTLY PROHIBITED in the Gulf Trace neighborhood, per neighborhood covenants. Pelican Trace borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald, green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside,"wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed FOUR times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. First Level: Foyer. Powder Room. Enclosed Outdoor Shower. Laundry Room (stackable w/d). Screened Porch with beverage fridge. Second Level: Living Room (fireplace decorative only). Powder room. Fully equipped kitchen. Dining table seats 8. Bar seating for 4. 1 bedroom. 1 bath. Covered balcony with Gulf glimpses. Screened porch with alfresco dining for 8 overlooks pool. #1 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, dual vanities, water closet. Third Level: 3 bedrooms. 3 baths. Wet bar with beverage fridge. Laundry room with utility sink. Covered balconies (one with Gulf glimpse, one overlooks pool). #2 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, vaulted ceiling, custom closet (can fit pack-n-play), Gulf glimpse, covered porch overlooking pool, dual vanities, soaking tub, walk-in shower, water closet. #3 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, vaulted ceiling, double sink vanity, tub/shower (bath also opens into hallway). #4 En-Site Bedroom has a King bed, vaulted ceiling, double sink vanity, walk-in shower. Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 6 Smart Tv’s (no local cable; streaming services available with guest personal login credentials) Distinctive Features Luxurious new construction with high-end finishes Gulf and State Park views Private saltwater pool All showers with rainshower faucets (3 with add’l handheld shower heads) Wood flooring throughout; marble flooring in bathrooms Bed, bath, and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 4 vehicles 4 King beds 4 full bathrooms, 2 powder rooms, iron, ironing board, 4 hair dryers, enclosed outdoor shower, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, three outdoor covered porches, two screened porches, porch furniture. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen with Quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, island with farmhouse sink, prep sink, ThinQ stainless French door fridge with water/ice dispenser, Bosch stainless dishwasher, ILVE Nostalgie Series Italian gas range, 2 beverage refrigerators, wet bar, pantry, microwave, dishwasher, drip coffee maker, toaster oven, blender, 2 washers and dryers. * Please note – no local channels on any Smart TV’s, streaming services available with guest account login. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) “Downtown” Grayton (1.5 miles) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
